name: Printed in the paper by the light of the negative, and mounted

roughness.note: No gloss of an early print was read: a first value between the matte salted and cyanotype papers and the semi-gloss of albumen.

roughnessAcross.source: a paper's face has no grain the eye resolves

haziness.note: One specular lobe until a goniometric measurement shows a second.

textureDepth.note: A first value for a smooth photographic paper's surface.

relief.source: the image carries the paper's texture
relief.derivation: no relief is drawn over the work's own image
